description: Settle canonical rukie checkout (git-renewed/rukie vs ruk/rukie) and record it in both AGENTS.md files
Mark Forgejo-bound decisions in ruk/.omp/plans/AGENT_NATIVE_GIT_PLAN.md:92-96 and old ruk/tasks ledger entries superseded, naming what carries over
Write product statement, named non-goals, and audience into rukie README
Record SQLite metadata store decision and no-compat-migrations-before-v0.1 rule
Restructure plan into vertical slices S0-S11 with per-slice Ruk prerequisites; dissolve separate Phases R, U, V
Make S0 acceptance script (repo.create via JSON HTTP, MCP, CLI, HTML; stock git push/clone; HTML tree view) a permanent CI gate
Make Ruk daemon protocol contract-first: schema source of truth, generated Go client, per-method conformance tests, Ruk commit pin in rukie CI
Set daemon-path budgets targeting incremental fetch (7.5x git) and single-ref lookup (4x git) plus clone/advertisement checks, with load harness; gate dogfood on them
Refresh stale ruk/README.md transport, HTTP client, and capacity claims from source and tasks/capacity/RESULTS.md
Remove Ruk Forgejo residue only after rukie S0 e2e passes; land R1 neutral ruk serve rename as clean cutover
Adopt licence provenance rule: port only campaign-authored Ruk patch code from GPL-3.0 ruk/forgejo, keep rukie MIT, record provenance
Limit K2 op table to S0 ops across JSON HTTP/OpenAPI, MCP, CLI, HTML; allow per-op HTML template overrides
Ship token scopes in S0 and op/repo-selector scopes plus orgs/teams in S3, before CI
Write falsifiable CI v1 bar (durable restart, CAS step cache key, one attestation per job, bounded idempotent retry) and single-host sandbox scope
Map open Ruk gaps (symrefs, bounded ref list, shallow fetch, LFS sync, reflog page) to the slices needing them
Order push mirrors (S2) before dogfood and require GitHub mirror for self-hosted ruk/rukie
Start dogfooding ruk and rukie development on self-hosted rukie when S2 and perf gate pass
Define change-as-review-unit model with branch view as read-only projection
Decide default supervision of Ruk daemon by rukie with external-socket flag
Defer SSH to S8 and assign termination design (OpenSSH ForceCommand vs in-process Go SSH) to ENG
Version op table as /v0, freeze webhook event schemas per type at S6, changelog every breaking rename
Freeze Ruk store format behind explicit store-version bump once dogfood starts
Bound search v1 to index-free capped cursor-paginated Ruk scan; allow index only after measured p95 miss
Require each slice to ship agent write path plus human HTML read view and add its e2e flow to the gate
Block any external user on security review of token scopes, CI sandbox, mirror credentials, webhook signing

Ratify the "operations ledger" art direction: dense typographic supervision console as signed-in home, tables over cards, monospace identity columns, one accent + 5-status vocabulary, no decorative chrome; every downstream token/template decision depends on it and it is the project's visual identity.

Fix the URL taxonomy and navigation model: /owner/repo tabs code|changes|branches|tasks|ci|releases|mirrors|settings, change/<id> and task/<id> as direct children, global /explore, /inbox, /review, /ops, /-/admin, /-/jump, GET-only reads, ?after= cursor pagination, full filter state in the URL; URLs are the UI's public API — cheapest to freeze before any template exists.

Publish the closed zero-JS interaction inventory (adopting the sibling catalogue): <details> disclosures/menus, GET-form filters + Link: rel=next, POST-303-GET with _idem→request_id, dedicated GET confirm pages for destructive actions (no modals, no <dialog>, no popovers, no :target/:checked state), user-select: all copy blocks, <datalist> suggestion-only, ?hl=N-M+#L highlight, formaction/formtarget=_blank previews, meta-refresh >=15 s opt-in on live surfaces only; prevents per-page re-invention and a11y-damaging CSS tricks.

Pin the vocabulary: protocol enums verbatim (live|superseded|ambiguous, enforce|advise, confirmed|rejected|uncertain, change/revision/stack/land); conventional attestation kinds/results (review/ci/task, approved/changes-requested/pass/fail) since protocol accepts free text; account · agent:<token> actor label; describe=POST mutation vs show/diff/attest.list=reads recorded; eliminates synonym drift across UI/docs/API.

Ratify the derived-vs-authored split (plan-level decision, gates U1): op registry derives forms + result views for every op; hand-authored templates for ~15 core surfaces (auth, code, change, stack, task, CI job, ops console, inbox, review queue); both consume identical op data so HTML and JSON cannot diverge; resolves the tension between one-table-derives-everything and designed-surface quality.

Define the token contract: private --_* primitives, public semantic tokens (--fg, --fg-muted, --surface-1..3, --border, --accent, --status-*, --mono), cascade layers, light/dark via prefers-color-scheme + per-user data-scheme override and color-scheme property; names lock in U0 while values stay iterable.

Author light and dark palettes: tinted neutrals (no pure #000/#fff), one non-default accent, five status hues, every fg/surface pair >=4.5:1 verified mechanically in both schemes; status safety via text+shape so no color-deficiency palette variants are needed.

Set typography: system UI + system monospace stacks only (no webfonts — build-free, no external fetches), five-step scale, tabular-nums numeric columns, absolute timestamps + title; matches the ledger direction and keeps identity columns scannable.

Write the component markup contract incl. motion budget: status chips (glyph+text), dense ops tables with fixed column order actor · op · repo · subject · status · age, avatars, pagination, GOV.UK-style error panels, provenance/attestation ledger rows, explain-this-change <details> card, filter bars, ~24 inline SVG icons (aria-hidden default); motion = opacity/transform/color transitions <=150 ms ease-out, no animation on first paint, one CSS-only CI spinner, global prefers-reduced-motion kill.

Build the page shell: header with global nav + inbox/ops/jump entries, repo tab bar, skip-to-content link, landmarks (header/nav/main/footer), <title> convention repo · surface, degraded-repo banner slot; every page inherits chrome and a11y structure from one shell.

Build the diff and code-render engine: stacked single-column diff from DiffReply{files} pages, file headers with anchors, context-collapse via server links, binary/LFS fallbacks, server-side chroma-class syntax highlighting (already in-tree via view_file heritage; ownership flagged as R-input); hardest component, gates browsing and review.

Design repo code surfaces: tree listing, file view with blame toggle (LineRange), branch/tag pickers as <details> menus, clone URL block (smart-HTTP + SSH), commit log, compare/merge-base page, archive download, search results; replaces deleted templates/repo/ on R2 read methods.

Design the change page: status header + effective attestation per kind, revision list (each = exact OID), stacked diff with revision-range selector (since last review), attestation ledger incl. superseded/ambiguous, evergreen discussion threads anchored to change-id + subject with content-derived staleness, describe-edit form (POST describe), land action gated by evaluate_requirements; the product's core human loop.

Design stack and branch views: /changes grouped by stack in dependency order with per-change status, /branches/<name> grouping a branch's changes (the PR-mental-model bridge), /review global queue filtered by attestation requirements awaiting the viewer; makes the Gerrit-like model navigable without Ruk knowledge.

Design the task surface (claim-board): task list as live claim.list × attestation render — columns unclaimed | claimed (holder+TTL) | attested-done are derived states not drag targets — task page claim block with holder account · agent:<token>, path scope, enforce|advise, TTL countdown (3600 s default), claim/release POSTs, linked changes/CI; the agent work-intake surface.

Design CI surfaces: run list, job page with step table, plain-text log page with opt-in meta-refresh (>=15 s) while running + terminal state on finish (no streaming — rejected), per-repo CI tab, result attestations (kind:ci, pass|fail) rendered on the subject change; replaces the deleted Actions UI.

Design the ops console: risk-ranked attention queue (diff size × conflicts × missing attestations × claim contention), batch landing parade form (group commit, per-change receipts), held claims across repos, running CI, mirror uncertain|rejected backlog, supersede radar (overlapping claim paths → abandon), ambiguous queue — fan-out bounded by metadata-store cache (R-input: cross-repo cost); the surface the product exists for.

Design inbox + feeds: notification rows (review requested, claim overlap, task claimed-by, CI fail on owned change, mention), read/unread, per-row mark-read POST, repo filter, Atom feeds for inbox/explore; the only push channel since email is cut.

Design auth/account surfaces: argon2id login + TOTP step-up, OIDC redirect entry, token management listing token-name · capability scopes · last-used, profile, user settings incl. per-user scheme + console refresh toggles; token scoping is where humans grant agents their ceilings.

Design remaining surfaces: org/team pages (members, repo lists, capability grants), mirror settings + status (per-mirror exact|ff-only, ref selection all|default+tags|globs, per-ref confirmed|rejected|uncertain history + LLM-content-policy copy where relevant), releases (tag + attestation), explore/stars/watches/forks, admin console via derived path; completes the ~30-page inventory.

WCAG 2.2 AA verification pass: contrast sweep both schemes (4.5:1 text per 1.4.3, 3:1 non-text per 1.4.11), focus-visible per 2.4.7, keyboard walk of every core flow (no traps — <details> + dedicated confirm pages only), >=24 px targets per 2.5.8, 400 % reflow, prefers-reduced-motion + forced-colors runs, error-summary/label audit; AA is a V-phase launch gate verified here on finished surfaces.

Freeze the Op-table contract (naming `<noun>_<verb>`, envelope, RFC 9457 error shape with `recovery`+`trace_id`, versioning/alias rule) and write it as the single deriving source for HTTP+MCP+CLI+HTML.

Implement HTTP conventions once in shared helpers: RFC 9457 problems, replayable opaque keyset cursors bound to query+expiry with `Link` next/prev, `ETag`/`If-Match` with 412/428, validated `Idempotency-Key` with daemon `request_id` passthrough, `E_LIMIT`→429 for rate/quota with `Retry-After` and →413 for oversized payloads, 429+`Retry-After`.

Cap and name the MCP surface (≤36 tools heuristic budget, `<noun>_<verb>`, merge reads via `include`, stable names with alias+Sunset on rename) derived strictly from the Op table with no degraded-semantics tools.

Set real MCP `ToolAnnotations` on every tool (`title`, `readOnlyHint`, `destructiveHint`, `idempotentHint`, `openWorldHint`, verb-first description, scope hints) and verify annotations via `go-sdk` v1.8.0 types.
Ship generated `rukie <op>` CLI invariants: `--json` stdout purity, `--in -|@file` + `--set`, mirrored Ruk `E_*` exit-code table, `--dry-run/--trace-id/--idempotency-key/--wait` on all mutations.

Define and enforce the token-scope matrix (`repo`/`change`/`task`/`ci`/`mirror`/`release`/`org`/`admin`, confinement, short-lived agent defaults, minter-holds-scopes) with missing-scope errors naming the mint command.
Serve `Accept: application/json|text/markdown|text/plain` + `?format=` on all read ops, generated from Op schemas with `Vary`/`Content-Location` correctness.
Generate `/llms.txt`, `/llms-full.txt`, and per-op markdown from the Op table with an agent-start-here path and a freshness CI gate.
Standardize error recovery payloads: every error carries exact next command, `current_etag`/`holder`/`expires_at`/`merge_base` where applicable, docs anchor, and `trace_id` across HTTP/MCP/CLI.
Render OpenAPI 3.1 server-side (zero JS `/docs`, per-op pages with curl/rukie/MCP-JSON snippets, `?q=` filter) directly from the Huma spec with no hand-written API guide.
Deliver one-command local loop `rukie dev` (ephemeral `ruk serve` on temp socket+roots, seeded org/repo/tasks, printed URLs/credentials, `dev reset|seed`) timed in CI.
Ship single-TOML config with `RUKIE_*` overrides, precedence table, and `rukie config check` failing fast with line-numbered hints (socket/roots/DSN).
Ship audited admin CLI (`user reset-password`, `token mint|revoke|list`, `repo verify|repair|reindex-search`, `mirror run|retry|status`, `attest verify`, `inbox send-test`) as scoped Ops.
Lock shared list conventions (sort allowlist, `q` scoping to Ruk search capability, limit default 100 / max 1000 inherited from Ruk limits, replayable cursors) in one helper + doc.
Standardize rate-limit/quota errors (429+`Retry-After`, quota body, `recovery.backoff_ms`) on CI/search/mirror hot paths with agent backoff guidance.
Ship webhook DX (`webhook_send_test`, delivery replay, Standard Webhooks signature examples per receiver language) alongside the webhook feature.
Publish versioning/deprecation policy (versioned OpenAPI, `Sunset` header + changelog entry + dual-run window for renames) and apply it to the first renamed op/scope.

Add the DX parity gate in CI asserting Op table → HTTP routes + MCP tools + CLI commands + docs pages + llms.txt stay in lockstep (drift = red); implement at K2 alongside DX-01/DX-02 and enforce thereafter.
Present the reconciliation table as a dated revision proposal for AGENT_NATIVE_GIT_PLAN.md and edit that plan only for user-approved items.
After approval, add an ignore entry for the nested ruk/rukie/ clone and never delete it.

Under the settled Gitea-cut decision confirmed at the gate, make one reversible rukie commit deleting the Gitea tree, setting module github.com/gosuda/rukie, adding a minimal rukie serve, new Makefile, CI and AGENTS.md, and keeping LICENSE.
Go gates in the new rukie CI: gofmt, go vet, golangci-lint v2, govulncheck, go test -race and fuzz tests.
R1a: rename the daemon to ruk serve and the handshake profile to host, and reword Forgejo-specific daemon docs and tests.

R1b step 1: add a ruk host-credential subcommand to ruk's own CLI that generates the random credential and writes it as a 0640 file owned by the daemon's service account in a group whose only members are the daemon and rukie uids, with named errors and a test asserting owner, group and mode.

R1b step 2: run the daemon as uid A and rukie as uid B with allowed_uids=[B], carry a fresh single-use per-connection challenge in the handshake accept reply, require an HMAC over (challenge, asserted_principal, method) keyed by the ENG-06 credential, refuse a reused challenge and any second assertion on a bound session, bind the principal to the daemon session, attribute sessions, leases, receipts and attestations to it, and test correct, missing and wrong HMACs, replayed opens, reused challenges, second assertions and refusal of non-allowed uids and of the allowed uid without a valid credential, documenting that same-uid-as-rukie processes are out of protocol scope.
R1c: one task per stream with a per-connection frame writer.
R1d: stream input/output in both directions under credit windows and spill received packs to disk.
R1e: stream keepalives and a subscription class exempt from the 60 s frame timeout.

R1f: keep RequestClass pub(crate), add public ExecutorLane mirroring all five RequestClass variants (Control, Interactive, Bulk, Hook, Maintenance) with a Method-to-lane mapping derived from the dispatcher, classify argv CommandOpen streams by verb on the server side with unknown verbs on Bulk and never Hook or Control, reserve BoundedExecutor permits per lane held inside the spawn_blocking closure, and add cancellation, mapping-consistency and verb-table tests.

Keep ruk gates green (fmt, 3-OS clippy -D warnings, nextest, cargo test, Unix cfg gating, no #[allow], unreachable_pub clean, exact pins, --locked) and add 60 s fuzz of frame, pkt-line and git-wire decoders plus the Miri gate on the existing plan's supported unsafe paths.
Two independent processes with two systemd units and two service accounts, a uid-restricted socket and no child-spawn mode.
K3: SQLite WAL store module with forward-only migrations and a leased outbox/job table.

K2: Op[In,Out] registry on Huma v2 and net/http ServeMux deriving OpenAPI 3.1, RFC 9457 errors, MCP tools (go-sdk v1.8.0), the generated rukie CLI and zero-JS HTML forms, with authn, authz and rate-limit middleware slots.
Auth: argon2id passwords with TOTP, OIDC redirect flow, sessions, scoped tokens on human accounts, and admin-CLI password reset.
Users, orgs, teams and repository permissions enforced in the operation-table authz middleware.
Design tokens as CSS custom properties and base layouts, with each later feature shipping its zero-JS pages from its operations.
R2a part 1: tree and object readers serving hosted diff/show/file/blame, fix the stale daemon doc claiming op.log, claim.list and attest.list serve only first pages, and exclude status.
R2b: hosted preparation for bookmark.*, tag.*, land.execute, push, push.reconcile, fetch, unpin and op.prune.
Crash test proving lane receipts survive a daemon kill at each mutation step and that replay is a no-op.
R2c: registry lifecycle (create/delete/rename/fork), tree listing, paginated refs and compare/merge-base reads.
testruk harness running the real daemon that fails, never skips, when the binary is missing.
K4: pooled daemon client with semaphore, cancellation, schema codegen and a one-to-one RFC 9457/MCP error map, tested on testruk.
RUK_PIN plus a schema-digest drift gate and a handshake version check.
Repo hosting and browsing feature: create/rename/delete ops and tree, blob, commit and diff pages and API.
Typed git-wire methods git.upload_pack (v0+v2), git.receive_pack and git.upload_archive admitted in the Bulk lane.
Keep quarantine and all hook phases (pre-receive, update, post-receive, proc-receive, fail-closed timeouts) unchanged and add typed hosted handlers for each phase.
rukie Smart HTTP and SSH frontends (x/crypto/ssh) that authenticate via ENG-16, authorize via ENG-17 and forward byte streams to the git-wire methods.
Walking-skeleton e2e: stock git clone, fetch v2, push and push refs/for/main over HTTP and SSH through the ENG-29 frontends to the daemon.
Process-trace test proving no git process runs inside the rukie plus daemon boundary.
Finish the slice-5 production graph index over store segments so revset evaluation runs outside tests.
R2a part 2: hosted log/query on the production graph index.
History and branch-view pages and ops grouping a branch's changes.
R2d: durable ordered op-log tail with a resumable subscription across op.prune.
Op-log consumer with one transaction for cursor and outbox, idempotent keys and a broadcast for long-wait operations.
Webhook delivery with Standard Webhooks signatures, idempotent ids, backoff, dead-letter, circuit breaker and an SSRF guard.
In-app inbox fed by the outbox, with no email delivery.
Per-token and per-account token buckets in the operation-table middleware with Retry-After.
R6: claim extensions for claimable tasks and attestation kinds for CI results and review approvals; claim and attestation cursor paging already exists.
Review feature: changes and stacks from refs/for with change-ids, branch view, approvals as attestations and merge via land.execute.
Tasks feature replacing issues, claimable through Ruk leases.
CI core with a leased DAG, content-addressed cache, chunked logs, persisted request ids, git-wire-only runners and results as attestations.
Reuse MergeNotice unchanged and report effective mode and language_set_version on every mergeability and land result.
R4: push with credentials per call, mirror mode, ref selection and per-ref status on mirror.rs.
Mirror worker with one run per mirror and dirty-flag rerun, reconcile, credentials only in memory and per-ref ff-only rejections.
R3: bounded search method in the Bulk lane with deadline, result cap and cancellation, plus the rukie search op and page.
Releases backed by hosted tag.* with streaming archive downloads.
Social features: explore, stars, watches and forks via registry fork.
Repo import through ruk's offline Git conversion with verify and rollback, exposed as an admin CLI operation.
Retention and maintenance stress under rukie load, with maintenance and backups only through daemon methods in the Maintenance lane.
Kill-9 fault suite for rukie and daemon mid-push, mid-webhook, mid-CI-attest and mid-mirror, plus ruk crash/lock/IO smoke tests and shuttle cases.
Run the reference capacity profile against rukie and the daemon as the release gate, deciding the metadata store.
Land the corpus, pad, and strict-validation commits exactly as Step 0 specifies, with every PRE and POST check.
Run the Dogfood gate on the workstation instance and ask the user before the first gosuda/rukie mirror sync.
Load Bunny Fonts through one no-referrer stylesheet link and widen the CSP to fonts.bunny.net for style-src and font-src only.
Gate the per-route cold render budgets with TestRenderRouteBudgets over recorded Ruk fixtures.
Ship the UI surfaces each F step names, including the ops console, CI run and log pages, mirror settings, and auth pages.
Register CI ops under the closed verb set: ci.run.update, ci.log.get, ci.artifact.get, ci.runner.create, ci.spec.verify.
Add the repo:create scope for owner-namespace create and fork, and rename tasks scopes to intents scopes.
Build the CLI session file for session-only ops, written by rukie auth login at mode 0600.
Gate the MCP default tool set at 36 tools with TestMCPDefaultToolBudget.
Build the K7 spool-first shim, timer drain, tip-comparison reconciler, and invocation-id dedupe.
Cap ruk serve restarts at three with 1, 2, 4 s backoff, flip /readyz, and fail daemon calls fast with 503.
Generate the secret key with rukie admin secret-gen, record its id in backups, and refuse restore on a key-id mismatch.
Enforce git-wire authorization: username equals token owner, visibility floors, refs/for at read, LandOnly, no self-approval.
Carry push and mirror credentials only in TransportAuth and per-call vars (CS-R29, CS-R30).
Create resolve_search_root with the CS-R13 hosted read arms so CS-R18 search reuses it.
Fix every pre-existing clippy failure in the first Ruk commit under -D warnings.
Set up strict validation for rukie with seven failing SC tests and record the ruk refusal.
Pass EventSource::ReceivePack from apply_refs and update every Store::publish caller in CS-R09.
Adopt ReScript + Preact as the web app stack via the generic JSX transform; Go+templ becomes the no-JS fallback (O41).
Ship the web app as an embedded ES-module bundle; no second API contract beside the op table (O41).
Scaffold web/: rescript.json with jsx.module=Preact, Preact.res generic-JSX interface, PreactHooks.res; pins rescript 12.3.1, preact 11.0.1, esbuild 0.28.2.
Wire esbuild bundle to internal/web/assets with go:embed and content-hash serving (O41).
Demote the Go render layer to fallback; delete internal/web/zerojs; keep trusted/htmlcheck and fix the CodeQL data: URL-scheme gap.
Replace zero-JS gates with TestAllHTMLRoutesRenderWithoutJS, TestNoJSFallbackMutationsPost, TestEmbeddedAppBundle, TestNoJSAppSource.
Defer dogfood until F1 to F14 all land (O40).

Settle the CI scope override (D2): the settled answers supersede arch-sketch-monolith section 11 hedge; control-plane ci.toml matrix expansion, artifacts, and the content-addressed cache are in scope with a matrix-free runner.
